title: Industrial Product Line Matcher
description: Thirteen illustrative jobs in shuffled order: recommend one of 13 industrial and application product lines (one scored attempt), then choose the feature that decides the job from three options (scored separately). The summary lists missed jobs with their reasons.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Matching industrial jobs to product lines
learningObjectives: The learner will recommend the product line that best fits each of 13 industrial job descriptions, justifying the choice by the deciding feature, with at least 10 of 13 correct on the first attempt.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); verdicts, the feature options, each new job and the summary announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; native select for the 13 lines; keys 1-3 choose a feature and Enter checks and goes on; focus moves to Check after a choice and to Next after a check.

controls.label: Check line / Check feature
controls.purpose: Check the current step (Enter); one scored attempt each

controls.label: Next job / See summary
controls.purpose: Advance after both steps are checked (Enter)

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: New scored round in a new order

rules: Exactly one product line is correct per job; one scored attempt
The three feature options are the correct feature and two distractors, shuffled; one scored attempt
The line is checked first; the feature question appears after it
Mastery counts lines only: 10 of 13 on the first attempt
limitations: Recommends a product line only; sizing and options come from the current catalog

sources: Product line definitions: Chapter 6, drawing on FanPedia pp. 4-8, 31-32, 62, 83, 115, 123, 138, 167, 171-172 and current tcf.com product and application pages

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Recommend from a job description, then justify with the deciding feature rather than keyword matching
keyQuestions: Does the material pass through the fan, or is the fan on the clean side of a filter?
Is the job high pressure at low volume, or large volume at moderate pressure?
commonMisconceptions: Any dirty-air job takes a radial bladed fan, even on the clean side of a filter
An air kit is a complete fan with housing and supports
Pressure blowers are chosen for large airflow
Plug fans and plenum fans are the same thing
assessmentOpportunities: Running scores 'Lines correct: n of 13' and 'Features correct: n of 13'; mastery is 10 of 13 lines on the first attempt.
